parts.name: Translation Panel (Left Sliding Pane)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left sliding glass panel of the window, made primarily of glass with a supporting frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the window to open or close by sliding horizontally, providing ventilation and access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally along the track within the window frame.

parts.name: Translation Panel (Right Sliding Pane)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right sliding glass panel of the window, made of glass and framed for structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It functions similarly to the left panel, sliding horizontally to open or close the window.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally in the opposite direction of the left panel along the same track.

parts.name: Base Body (Window Frame)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the window, made of aluminum for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and guides the sliding panels, providing structural integrity and housing for the glass panes.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base for the sliding components.
